title: PostgreSQL permission
description: One permission in PostgreSQL's own terms (D68): membership of a role, a privilege on a database, or EXECUTE on a function. Exactly one of role, database or function is named.

oneOf.title: Role membership
oneOf.description: The connecting role holds the privileges of the named role, for example pg_monitor, pg_read_all_stats or pg_signal_backend.

oneOf.title: Database privilege
oneOf.description: A privilege on one database, or on every database that accepts connections and is not a template when database is "*".

oneOf.title: Function privilege
oneOf.description: EXECUTE on the function schema.name; a name shared by several overloads is granted when every overload is.
